name: Serpentico Smash
review:
A Mesoamerican temple on a 6x5 cluster grid, where winning symbols and scatters crush the symbols beneath them instead of just vanishing.

That crush changes how the next cascade lands, which makes chains feel a bit less random than in most cluster games. High volatility, 5,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.18%, below average, so it's one to try in demo before playing for real.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
